idea-plugin.name: Alpaca
idea-plugin.description:
IDE support for custom languages defined with the Alpaca lexer/parser library for Scala.

An Alpaca-defined language is just Scala code, with no separate grammar file to point an IDE at. This plugin reads the grammar data your lexer{...}/parser macros already compute, exported to disk at compile time, and turns it into a working custom language in the IDE for any language you define, without writing any plugin code yourself.

  • Syntax highlighting inferred from each token's regex shape.
  • A real parser that drives your grammar's exact, conflict-resolved LR table and reports syntax errors as ordinary red squiggles.
  • Structure View and code folding that mirror the parsed tree.
  • Autocompletion of the fixed-spelling terminals valid at the caret.
  • Line comment toggling for grammars with a prefix.*-shaped ignored rule.
  • Reformat Code that spaces and indents around your grammar's brackets, commas, semicolons, and dots, however they're spelled.
  • Highlight occurrences of the identifier under the caret, everywhere it appears in the file.
  • TODO markers in comments feed the TODO tool window and the commit check.

Point Settings | Tools | Alpaca at your grammar export directory and map file extensions to grammars. See the documentation for details.
